records.context: Isolated fixture with a fake HTTP transport and no credentials.
records.outcome: The normalized success and error paths were validated without network access.
records.constraints_or_lessons: This does not establish production-provider compatibility or rate-limit behaviour.

records.use_case: Use a read-only provider health probe before a solution workflow begins.
assumptions: The provider exposes a cheap read-only endpoint.
validation_required: Prove the endpoint has no side effects and is available to the solution account.
